create_BodyBboxDetector_yolo: create a BodyBboxDetector with method yolo to detect human bounding boxes in a BGR image
create_BodyBboxDetector_2dpose: create a BodyBboxDetector with method 2dpose to detect human bounding boxes using pose estimation
run_detectBbox: run detectBbox on a BGR image to get a list of XYWH bounding boxes for detected humans
run_Yolo_detectHuman: run Yolo_detectHuman with a loaded YOLO model and camera frame to extract human bounding boxes
run_pose2d_detectHuman: run pose2d_detectHuman with a pose estimation model and image to detect human poses and keypoints
